speaker: alice
text: Let's kick off with something genuinely awe inspiring, Alex. Up around Hervey Bay, whale watchers are reporting massive humpback super pods as the annual migration hits its spring peak, dozens of whales at a time putting on an absolute show for anyone lucky enough to be out on the water.

speaker: charlie
text: Love that. It's a timely reminder of why we protect these waters in the first place, these giants swim right past our doorstep every single year and somehow it never gets old. Good on the tour operators and marine rangers keeping a respectful eye on them too.

speaker: alice
text: Closer to the reef, volunteer divers with Reef Check have been out doing their bit as well, and the early word is the coral is looking healthy heading into spawning season. It's proof that when everyday Queenslanders roll up their sleeves for citizen science, our reef gets a fighting chance.
